Below is a curated list of my research outputs, grouped into **Publications**, **Working Papers**, and **Policy Contributions**. Where possible, I include links to the publisher page, open-access versions, and related policy write-ups.

## Publications

::: {.pub-item}
**The Macroeconomics of AI Capacity: Insights from a Two-Asset Growth Model** (2026)  
Jonathan Rice  
*Macroeconomic Dynamics*, 30, e22  
<span class="pub-links">
<a href="https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/macroeconomic-dynamics/article/abs/macroeconomics-of-ai-capacity-insights-from-a-twoasset-growth-model/BA6A3F533F88E96FD0E7E09B1B0CA049">Cambridge Core</a>
<a href="https://doi.org/10.1017/S1365100526100911">DOI</a>
</span>

This paper develops a two-asset growth framework for thinking about AI capacity as an economic asset, with implications for hardware obsolescence, investment dynamics, welfare, and policy.
:::

::: {.pub-item}
**Riding the rate wave: Interest rate and run risks in euro area banks during the 2022-2023 monetary cycle** (2026)  
Jonathan Rice, Giulia Maria Guerrini  
*Journal of International Money and Finance*, 160, 103444  
<span class="pub-links">
<a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0261560625001792">Journal</a>
<a href="https://www.ecb.europa.eu/pub/pdf/scpwps/ecb.wp3090~4852851923.en.pdf">Working paper (ECB WP 3090)</a>
<a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5383748">SSRN</a>
<a href="https://cepr.org/voxeu/columns/interest-rate-and-deposit-run-risk-new-evidence-euro-area-banks-2022-2023-tightening">VoxEU</a>
<a href="https://www.suerf.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SUERF-Policy-Brief-1263-_Rice_Guerrini.pdf">SUERF Policy Brief</a>
</span>

This paper studies how the 2022-2023 interest-rate tightening affected euro area banks' economic net worth and their vulnerability to deposit runs, using granular supervisory data.

**VoxEU**
- [Interest rate and deposit run risk: New evidence from euro area banks during 2022-2023 tightening](https://cepr.org/voxeu/columns/interest-rate-and-deposit-run-risk-new-evidence-euro-area-banks-2022-2023-tightening)

**SUERF Policy Brief**
- [Why euro area banks stayed resilient amid rising rates (Policy Brief No. 1263)](https://www.suerf.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SUERF-Policy-Brief-1263-_Rice_Guerrini.pdf)
:::

::: {.pub-item}
**Economic Policy Uncertainty Shocks in Small Open Economies: A Case Study of Ireland** (2023)  
Jonathan Rice  
*The Economic and Social Review*, 54(4), 217-245  
<span class="pub-links">
<a href="https://www.esr.ie/article/view/2531">Journal</a>
